description: Rh-catalysed arylation of racemic 3-chlorocyclohexene (van Dijk et al., Nat. Catal. 2021): 13C KIEs on the product from the two enantiomeric channels, each from its Rh-bound reactant complex to its anti-oxidative-addition transition structure, relative to C5, with s = k(S)/k(R) = 3.3 (the second channel's share over the first's, as Kinisot prints it). Unscaled frequencies, as in the paper. Atom numbers are the same product carbon in both channels.
